title: Custom domain update for sciquiztn-knowledgebyte.in and Play Store (TWA/Bubblewrap) publishing documentation

requirements.summary: Update IC custom-domain configuration to use the full domain sciquiztn-knowledgebyte.in (not the bare label) so the app is accessible via https://sciquiztn-knowledgebyte.in.
acceptanceCriteria: `frontend/public/.well-known/ic-domains` contains `sciquiztn-knowledgebyte.in` (and does not rely on only the bare label without the TLD)
The custom domain documentation reflects `sciquiztn-knowledgebyte.in` consistently
After deployment, the app is reachable via `https://sciquiztn-knowledgebyte.in`

file_operations.description: Replace the current bare-label entry with the full custom domain `sciquiztn-knowledgebyte.in` (ensure the file contains the fully-qualified domain and no longer relies on `sciquiztn-knowledgebyte` alone).

requirements.summary: Rewrite the custom domain deployment doc in clear English with step-by-step setup and verification checklist for sciquiztn-knowledgebyte.in, including where it is configured in the repo.
acceptanceCriteria: The document explicitly names `sciquiztn-knowledgebyte.in` as the target domain
The document points to the exact file path `frontend/public/.well-known/ic-domains` as the domain configuration source
Instructions include a verification checklist (e.g., expected URL, basic smoke-test steps)

file_operations.description: Update the document to use `sciquiztn-knowledgebyte.in` consistently and provide clear step-by-step instructions: where to set the domain in-repo (explicitly reference `frontend/public/.well-known/ic-domains`), DNS records guidance at a high level, deployment steps, and a verification checklist (expected URL `https://sciquiztn-knowledgebyte.in`, basic smoke tests, and common troubleshooting notes).

requirements.summary: Add an English step-by-step guide for publishing the existing web app to Google Play using a Trusted Web Activity (Bubblewrap), tailored to https://sciquiztn-knowledgebyte.in and including Play Console assets/checklist.
acceptanceCriteria: A new documentation file exists under `frontend/` (or `frontend/docs/` if present in the repo) describing how to generate an Android App Bundle (.aab) via Bubblewrap/TWA for this app
The guide includes: prerequisites, commands/steps to build the TWA, where to set the start URL, how to produce the `.aab`, and Play Console submission checklist
The guide lists the required store listing assets (icon, feature graphic, screenshots) and links to the generated filenames from `frontend/public/assets/generated/`

file_operations.description: Create an English, step-by-step Bubblewrap/TWA publishing guide tailored to the deployed URL `https://sciquiztn-knowledgebyte.in`. Include: prerequisites (Node/Java/Android tooling), Bubblewrap installation, how/where to set the start URL (`https://sciquiztn-knowledgebyte.in`), steps/commands to initialize and build the TWA, how to produce an Android App Bundle (.aab), signing/keystore considerations (high-level), and a Play Console submission checklist. Also include a section listing required store assets and reference these exact repo files: `frontend/public/assets/generated/playstore-icon.dim_512x512.png`, `frontend/public/assets/generated/playstore-feature-graphic.dim_1024x500.png`, `frontend/public/assets/generated/playstore-screenshot-1.dim_1080x1920.png`, `frontend/public/assets/generated/playstore-screenshot-2.dim_1080x1920.png`.

requirements.summary: Add required static Play Store/TWA images under frontend/public/assets/generated and ensure the publishing guide references the exact filenames and intended usage.
acceptanceCriteria: The generated image files exist at `frontend/public/assets/generated/` with the exact filenames specified in this build request
The Play Store/TWA guide references these exact filenames and their intended usage (without requiring any backend routes to serve them)

file_operations.description: Add the required static asset image file at the exact path `frontend/public/assets/generated/playstore-icon.dim_512x512.png` for the Play Store app icon.
Add the required static asset image file at the exact path `frontend/public/assets/generated/playstore-feature-graphic.dim_1024x500.png` for the Play Store feature graphic.
Add the required static asset image file at the exact path `frontend/public/assets/generated/playstore-screenshot-1.dim_1080x1920.png` for a Play Store screenshot (quiz question screen mock).
Add the required static asset image file at the exact path `frontend/public/assets/generated/playstore-screenshot-2.dim_1080x1920.png` for a Play Store screenshot (results screen mock).

Ensure the guide explicitly references (by full workspace path) the four generated images under `frontend/public/assets/generated/` and describes each file’s intended Play Console usage (icon, feature graphic, screenshots), emphasizing they are served as static assets and do not require any backend routing.
